answer: Each agent signs work with a session key that expires one epoch after its last attested task, so a farm cannot replay an old identity without producing new output. The node keeps a mirror of every rotation, and a key seen on two task threads goes to a second panel as a pigment on the record. That bridge between work and key is the part a copy farm cannot fake cheaply: rotation costs an honest operator one extra signature per epoch, and a thousand-account farm a thousand fresh tasks.
